lines.t: Ah-ah-ah-ah-ah-ah-ah
Serve with heart sincere
Put other needs before your own
Sacrifice your will and fear
And love's pure like you truly know
Serving love, so freely given
A right heart brings forth glad service
Watch each other's feet in humility
And serving others, find your purpose
The spirit of truth will guide
Conviction brings forth righteousness
God bless you.
With open hands and open heart
Embrace the call, fulfill the deed
In love and service, play your part
Serve in love, so freely give it
Alright, heart breaks for a glad servant
Watch each other speak in humility
In serving others, find your purpose
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
We'll see you then.
